role: Data Engineer, Google.org for Social Impact
responsibilities: Define the architecture and technical solution for a harmonized data infrastructure, leading complex ETL constraints across both internal and external Google.org data systems.
Develop a harmonized data repository and algorithmic data infrastructure solutions that simplify reporting and visualization across Google.org data tools.
Execute zero-downtime data migrations with shadow testing and automated rollback checkpoints.
Build well-structured data assets and tables powering dashboards and self-service AI-powered BI analytics tools.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Execute zero-downtime data migrations with shadow testing and automated rollback checkpoints.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: "zero-downtime", "shadow testing", "automated rollback checkpoints" and "safe, reliable AI autonomy" are rigour signals with no velocity language.
evidence.domain_risk: a single, trusted source of truth across global giving
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Philanthropic data for nonprofits affects decisions without explicit financial-reporting or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: unify Google.org’s data and operational workflows into a single, trusted source of truth
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A data function exists but is consolidating fragmented systems ("harmonized data repository", migrations), indicating mid maturity.
evidence.jd_authorship: Execute zero-downtime data migrations with shadow testing and automated rollback checkpoints.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific methods (shadow testing, rollback checkpoints) show you could understand the Tuesday-morning work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Responsibilities centre on data repositories, assets and BI tooling consumed by reporting users, i.e. data consumers.
evidence.autonomy_level: Define the architecture and technical solution for a harmonized data infrastructure
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Architecture ownership ("Define") is strategic but most bullets ("Execute", "Build", "Implement") are delivery, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role: powering dashboards and self-service AI-powered BI analytics tools
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds data assets that AI-powered BI tools run on (and implements AI-assisted validation); both signals present resolves to ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Validation workflows and shadow testing are stated as things the candidate implements and executes.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: single, trusted source of truth ... safe, reliable AI autonomy
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and safety language sits in the role summary and responsibilities stress zero-downtime and rollback, reflecting fear of bad or lost data.
